sentences.text: A tall tree stands in the yard.
The tree drops leaves in autumn.
The forest is at the foot of the mountain.
The forest is full of birds.
An old man leans on a stick.
The child picked up a stick from the ground.
A stick stands by the tent.
Fresh fruit is in the basket.
In summer the fruit is sweet.
Fruit is cheap at the market.
I put a seed into the earth.
A small seed will soon sprout.
A yellow leaf fell on the ground.
A green leaf is on the branch.
The wind carried the leaf away.
An ant walks under the bark.
A red flower is in the vase.
The flower opens in the morning.
A flower smells sweet in the garden.
A strong rope is by the boat.
The skin of the hand is soft.
Meat is boiling in the pot.
In the evening we eat meat.
I buy meat for the evening.
Blood is coming from the gum.
The dog is gnawing a bone.
A bone is hard and white.
Fat is melting in the pan.
There is a lot of fat in the meat.
An egg is in the nest.
In the morning I boil an egg.
An ox horn is long and curved.
The animal has a horn on its head.
A horn is on display in the museum.
A fish tail hits the water.
A soft feather is on the ground.
Long hair falls on the back.
In the morning I comb my hair.
In cold wind the ear turns red.
The nose gets blocked when you have a cold.
His nose is red in the cold.
The tooth is white and healthy.
In the morning I brush my tooth.
The tongue is sensitive in the mouth.
The child sticks out his tongue.
A nail should be cut clean.
A long nail gets in the way.
A nail tapped on the table.
The foot gets wet in the water.
The knee rested on the ground.
A warm hand is on my shoulder.
The child held out a hand to me.
A wing moves in the air.
A soft belly rises with breath.
The neck is warmed by a scarf.
This bird has a long neck.
The neck is tired after work.
The back rests against the chair.
A heavy bag tired my back.
The back warms in the sun.
In cold air the breast tightens.
After running the heart works hard.
The doctor looks at the liver on a scan.
In hot weather drinking is frequent.
Spitting in the street is rude.
Vomiting is a sign of illness.
Blowing out a candle is easy.
A strong blow puts out the fire.
